en: Monochrome vintage postcard view of a grand, neoclassical building at the top of a broad staircase, fronted by a landscaped park with trees, shrubs, paths, and benches. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll and sit on benches. The central building has large arched windows, decorative reliefs above the entrance, and a mansard-style roof. A tall, ornate light structure or arch rises in front of the entrance. The overall style suggests a civic or cultural building such as a theater, spa hall, or Kurhaus. There is no visible printed caption on the front, only a small serial number in the lower left corner.
